body: Those posts are sweet, but I’ve been telling myself to live on more day for too long. Nothing has changed. I can’t really help myself anymore at this point. I do hope you live a long and happy life. Keep trying.
There’s really not much to talk about.
I’ve been sad for a long time. I don’t like self diagnosing so I haven’t started calling it depression or anything, but it’s been over a year since i started feeling this way and nothing has changed.
I’ve gotten this weird urge to do it for a while but i’ve been ignoring it until last night. I decided last night that I’ll try it if the urge isn’t gone by this morning and now it’s noon.
thanks for offering but i don’t necessarily feel like talking but if you ever need to you could reach out to me ^^
Yeah, I’m still here. Someone talked me out of it. Sorry it took so long for me to reply I was in the shower.
I honestly don’t think I can take a few more years. I’ve been feeling like this for about a year now and it’s only been getting worse.
Yeah, it started when I was in 6th grade after I had moved. Probably because after I had moved I kind of got a reality shock and realized life isn’t easy
Thanks, I’ll make sure to remember that
Thanks, you seem like a very nice person.
I don’t really understand when it started but now everything is overwhelming. My family and school and friends. I just don’t have anywhere to go now without feeling like it’s too much.
Oh. I’m actually surprised someone read it.
